notes.title: Patch 1.1 is out!
notes.content:
Hello,

We have released the first patch of Neon Parkour 2. This patch contains many bug fixes. Here are some bugs that we fixed:

- While in slowmotion mode, b-hop speed is slower than normal mode.
- Can't hold the hook while dashing
- Some part of challenger mode is impossible to move forward

We hope the game is in a state that you would like to see. Thank you for your support and feedbacks! Do not forget to write a review, we read them all!

notes.title: NEON PARKOUR 2 HAS GONE GOLD!
notes.content: The development process of Neon Parkour 2 has been completed and Neon Parkour 2 has gone gold! See you in July 6th!
